name: Thornward
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by magnetic pole anomalies and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
gravity well anomaly bends the local reality in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
